描述_EN: when wound up, the toy somersaults using the arms (wings) to lift it off the ground. the clockwork mechanism is housed inside the body. the colouring resembles that of a parrot. it was made in china probably for the local market rather than for export. this toy is probabaly meant to be a bird.
描述_ZN: 当上紧发条时，玩具会利用手臂（翅膀）将其抬离地面而翻筋斗。 发条机制被安置在身体内。 其颜色类似于鹦鹉的颜色。 它是在中国制造的，可能是为本地市场而不是为出口。 这个玩具可能是要做一只鸟。
